service.description: The links of the time screens under the mount (appRoot People or Projects, else Projects; links only, never authority): timeBase, the mount's time screens (/qapps/People/Time or /qapps/Projects/Time); recordBase, Projects' root for a work item's or a project's link, null for a user who does not open Projects (their own grants on its root, read directly as the Commons record links read them, so a grant inherited from the calling screen does not count).

actions.script: timeBase = '/qapps/' + (appRoot === 'People' ? 'People' : 'Projects') + '/Time' recordBase = null if (!ec.user.userId) return const groupIds = Array.from(ec.user.getUserGroupIdSet() || []) if (!groupIds.length) return const root = 'component://mr-boss/screen/Projects.xml' const rows = Array.from(ec.entity.find('moqui.security.ArtifactAuthzCheckView').condition('userGroupId', 'in', groupIds) .condition('artifactTypeEnumId', 'AT_XML_SCREEN').condition('authzActionEnumId', 'in', ['AUTHZA_ALL', 'AUTHZA_VIEW']) .disableAuthz().list()).filter((row) => row.nameIsPattern === 'Y' ? new RegExp(`^(?:${row.artifactName})$`).test(root) : row.artifactName === root) const opens = rows.some((row) => row.authzTypeEnumId === 'AUTHZT_ALWAYS') || (rows.some((row) => row.authzTypeEnumId === 'AUTHZT_ALLOW') && !rows.some((row) => row.authzTypeEnumId === 'AUTHZT_DENY')) if (opens) recordBase = '/qapps/Projects'

service.description: MyTime's week (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.get#PartyWeek) of the user, or of a person the user approves, with the rows added to it, each row's link; the running timer (own week); the work types the person's organization offers (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.get#WorkTypes, Settings' Time); the people the user may open (get#TimePeople: their own, the time keepers of the projects they manage and their live reports; ADMIN every time keeper); and lastWeekItemCount (the items with time in the week before, for Copy last week's rows). serverNow: the server's clock, for the ticking timer. The links follow the mount (appRoot, get#TimeLinks).

Whether the user may log their own time on a work item: a task they may update in Projects (ironstone.commons.TaskServices.get#TaskAccess app projects), or a project they are on (or see, with TIMESHEET_APPROVE as a Projects manager or ADMIN holds it). An error otherwise.
Whether the user may change a person's entries on a day (the week's timesheet access canEdit; a future day only when the policy allows it). An error otherwise.

A grid cell: the hours of a person on a work item (or none) on a day. With no entry there one is made (from the end of the day's last entry, else 9:00), with one its hours change (zero or empty removes it), with several the day's entries are edited one by one (an error). Hours are rounded to the policy's smallest entry, at most 24.

parameter.name: billable
parameter.description: Y or N; with no entry yet, default Y

service.description: One entry in full (MyTime's EntryForm, QuickTime): a person's (default the user's) time on a work item on a day, from and thru (HH:mm) or hours from 9:00, a break, billable (Y or N), the work type and a comment; timeEntryId changes that entry. The week's access and the item are checked as for save#WeekCell.
Removes an entry of a week the user may change (not invoiced, not the running timer).

The rows added to the user's own week without time (the preference ironstone.mytime.rows.weekStart): add (workEffortId, an item the user may log on), remove (workEffortId), or copyLast (the items with time in the week before, and the rows added to it).

The work items the user logs time on, as drop-down options (value, label): with no term the open items assigned to the user, then those with the user's time in the last four weeks; with a term the open items and projects of the user's projects (or every visible one with TIMESHEET_APPROVE, a Projects manager's) by key or name. Thirty at most.
Starts the user's timer on a work item they may log on (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.start#Timer: a timer on another item stops first).

actions.script: ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.TimeServices.check#TimeItem').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.TimesheetServices.start#Timer').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId, comments: comments || null}).call() || {} if (ec.message.hasError()) return timeEntryId = out.timeEntryId; alreadyRunning = !!out.alreadyRunning message = out.stoppedTimeEntryIds?.length ? ec.resource.expand('Switched: the timer runs on ${workEffortId}', '', {workEffortId}) : out.message

service.description: A week's flow from MyTime and TimesheetDetail: submit (the user's own week of weekDate, or timesheetId), approve, return (reason required) or reopen (reason) of timesheetId, through mantle.work.TimesheetServices, which checks who may.

Timesheets' rows (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.find#Timesheets) with their texts and links (the mount's, appRoot: get#TimeLinks), the counts of the chips, and the people of the find (those of the rows). With no list, an approver (a week waiting, or TIMESHEET_APPROVE) opens on To approve, anyone else on Mine.

Timesheets' bulk decisions on the selected rows, each on its own (a refused one is counted, the rest go on): approve, return (reason required), or remind (the people of the rows, TimesheetServices.send#MissingTimeReminders, the week of weekDate or of each row). selectedIds: a comma list of timesheet ids, or P:partyId for a missing week.

TimesheetDetail's timesheet, for one who may view it (else "not available"): mantle.work.TimesheetServices get#TimesheetSummary with its week, the entries by day (a day's header row then its entries, each with its texts), the totals by project and item, the flags, the status history (the status audit with who and when) and the actions the user may take. The links follow the mount (appRoot, get#TimeLinks).

Projects Home's time: the running timer (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.get#Timer, with its item's link) and, for an approver, the submitted weeks waiting (five, oldest first; find#Timesheets toApprove).

actions.script: timer = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.TimesheetServices.get#Timer').call()?.timer || null if (timer?.workEffortId) timer.url = (timer.workEffortId === timer.rootWorkEffortId ? '/qapps/Projects/Projects/ProjectDetail?workEffortId=' : '/qapps/Projects/WorkItems/WorkItemDetail?workEffortId=') + encodeURIComponent(timer.workEffortId) if (timer) timer.startedText = ec.l10n.format(String(timer.fromDate), 'h:mm a') approvalList = [] if (!managers) return const rows = Array.from(ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.TimesheetServices.find#Timesheets').parameters({list: 'toApprove', withCounts: false}) .call()?.rowList || []) rows.sort((a, b) => String(a.weekStart).localeCompare(String(b.weekStart)) || String(a.personName).localeCompare(String(b.personName))) approvalList = rows.slice(0, 5).map((row) => ({kind: 'timesheet', timesheetId: row.timesheetId, personName: row.personName, weekText: row.weekText, whatText: ec.l10n.localize('Timesheet') + ' · ' + row.weekText, sortDate: row.submittedDate ? Number(String(row.submittedDate)) : 0, hoursText: ec.l10n.format(row.hours, '#,##0.##') + ' h', sinceText: row.submittedDate ? ec.l10n.format(String(row.submittedDate), 'MMM d') : '', url: '/qapps/Projects/Time/TimesheetDetail?timesheetId=' + encodeURIComponent(row.timesheetId)}))

service.description: The people the user may log or find time for, as options (key, text): the user first, then for an approver the time keepers of the projects they manage (ADMIN every time keeper) and the user's live reports (People P10: mantle.work.TimesheetServices.get#LineReports, whose weeks a line manager approves under the line policy), and the person given. Each person's week is checked again where it is read or changed (get#TimesheetAccess).

TimeEntries' rows (design-projects.md §8 TimeEntries; ProjectTime with the project fixed): mantle.work.TimeServices find#TimeEntries over the time the user may see, by list (thisWeek, the default; lastWeek; thisMonth; unbilled: billable and not on a client invoice, any time; noItem: on no work item; all) and the find, each row with its texts and links, its week's status (Open, Returned, Submitted, Approved, or Invoiced, Running), and whether the user may change it (canEdit: not invoiced, not running, its week not locked, and the user its person or an approver of its week). Rates and amounts for those who manage money (TIME_ENTRY_RATE: the Projects managers and ADMIN): ratesShown; the worker rate and amount of an employee's time only with PAYROLL_VIEW (Mantle's find#TimeEntries leaves them out, vendorRateShown false). With withTotals the totals of every match (ProjectTime's box). A work item's and a project's link for a user who opens Projects (get#TimeLinks, appRoot).

The EditTimeEntry dialog's entry (design-projects.md §8): a new one (no timeEntryId: the user's, today, the item given) or one the user may see, with its values as the form takes them, whether the user may change it (canEdit, and lockText when not), and for those who manage money its rates (canRates; a locked entry's rates may still change while it is not invoiced): the worker rate of an employee's time (employed on the entry's date or now) is the employee's pay, shown with PAYROLL_VIEW (workerRateShown) and set with PAYROLL_EDIT (workerRateEditable; mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess), a contractor's with the client rate; the people the user may log for, the work types offered and the item's option.

An entry's client and vendor hour rates set by hand (hasModifiedRates Y), or found again from the rates (reset), for those who manage money; a locked week's entry too (the lock leaves rates changeable), never an invoiced one. The vendor rate of an employee's time (employed on the entry's date or now) is the employee's pay (mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess): without PAYROLL_EDIT it stays as it is, and one given that differs from it is refused.

TimeEntries' bulk changes on the selected entries (TimeEntryBulk), each on its own in its own transaction: a refused one is counted with its reason and the others go on. move (value: a work item the person may log on), workType (value: a work type, empty for none), billable (value Y or N), rates (found again from the rates; those who manage money; a submitted week's entries too), delete. Every change but rates and billable needs an entry the user may change (not invoiced, not running, its week open); billable on a submitted week is a money change, for those who manage money; nothing changes an invoiced entry.

ProjectTime's box (design-projects.md §4 ProjectTime): the project's time by person, by work item and by work type against the estimate, billable against not billable (find#TimeEntryRows withTotals over the find), the project's estimate (its estimatedWorkTime, rolled up from its items), and whether the user may update its rates (a manager of the project who manages money).
ProjectTime's Update rates: the rates of the project's entries not invoiced found again (mantle.work.TimeServices.resetAndGet#ProjectTimeEntryRates), by a manager of the project who manages money.

WorkItemDetail's All time box in Projects (design-projects.md §5 WorkItemDetail: everyone's time, rates for those who manage money): every entry on a work item the user sees (ironstone.commons.TaskServices.get#TaskAccess app projects), the latest first (100 at most), with who, the day, hours, work type, billable and the comment, the week's status, and the client and worker amounts for the Projects managers and ADMIN (the worker amount of an employee's time, employed on its date or now, is pay: only with PAYROLL_VIEW, mantle.humanres.EmploymentServices.get#PayRateAccess); the totals by person. Nothing for a client (PROJECT_CLIENT: impl-projects.md P10b): its hours are ProjectDetail's Hours (get#ClientHours), without names, comments or rates.

ProjectDetail's Hours for a client (design-projects.md §4 ProjectTime: "only when the project shares hours with the client, as hours by week and work item with no rates"; screen ProjectDetail/ClientHours.xml): for a client (PROJECT_CLIENT) of a client project that shares its hours (mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#ClientProjectInfo clientProjectIds and shareHoursProjectIds: WstShareHours, the project's or its organization's default), the hours of the entries the team stands behind: ended (no running timer), billable (not No Charge), on a work item shared with the client (a task of the project, All users or General), on an approved week or a client invoice. By week (the week's first day, Monday) and work item, the latest week first, with the totals by item and in all. Never who, a rate, an amount, a comment, the work type or the timesheet. shared is false, and nothing is read, for anyone else or any other project; a failure is logged and shows nothing.

TimeSettings (design-projects.md §12): the organization's timesheet policy (mantle.work.TimesheetServices get#TimesheetPolicy, as the form takes it) and its work types (get#WorkTypes: every WorkType, offered or not, in order).
TimeSettings' policy form, for the Projects managers (mantle.work.TimesheetServices.store#TimesheetPolicy on the settings organization): workDays a list or the digits of the days.

parameter.name: required
parameter.description: Y: every employee keeps a weekly timesheet (People P10: a line manager's missing lists count each report); not given keeps the stored value

service.description: TimeSettings' work types: offer or stop offering one, move it up or down, or rename one of the organization's own (change rename with label); for the Projects managers.
TimeSettings' NewWorkType: a work type of the organization's own, an Enumeration of WorkType (id WktpOrg and a number), offered at the end; for the Projects managers.
